units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:1">Neg. I, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>כק׳ ביצה</he> the color of the membrane surrounding the egg.
<cite ref="Chullin 43a:13">Ib. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ שעלה … אינו ק׳</he> a membrane formed in consequence of a wound in the gullet is no membrane (to make the gullet sound).
<cite ref="Chullin 56a:10">Ib. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>קְרוּמוֹ רך</he> its membrane is tender; a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְרוֹמִין</he>.
